about_the_game:
Welcome to DIORAMA BREAK! In this special JRPG, you must directly guide the hero on a journey to change the world (whether he likes it or not). Marshal your wits and fight your way through tactical turn-based battles and awkward conversations alike. Or don't. See what happens...

Features

  • Speak directly to the hero. They will respond in kind.

  • An innovative turn-based grid-based time-and-space-based tactical battle system (based).

    • Actions take place over multiple turns, with startup, active time, and recovery time.

    • Both Player and Enemy units plan their actions ahead of time then execute them simultaneously.

    • Time your moves carefully to slip past your opponents’ defenses.

    • Inspired by fighting game concepts such as footsies, frame data, and attack interruption.

  • Expertly composed world-class hand-crafted traditionalist pixel environments and animations. Amazing stylistic achievements such as:

    • Modern procedurally generated visual effects and shaders (that nonetheless remain tastefully traditionalist)

    • Stylized, palletized light and shadow

    • anime

    • NO MIXELS

    • 4K visual novel scenes...?

  • Intuitive yet deep character customization for combat. Equip weapons to gain new actions in combat; combine equipment to create unique synergies. Leveling up lets you choose between unique, mutually exclusive passive bonuses, rather than simple stat boosts.

  • A narrative with layers.

  • Interject during dialogue to make your opinion known.

  • A genre-hopping soundtrack that reacts to gameplay.

  • Explore varied and fantastical biomes and settlements on a miniature continent.

  • Accessible controls and gameplay. Can be played with only a mouse, no action-based challenges.

  • High quality software backend; built on top of a custom 2D game engine for maximum performance and ease-of-use.

  • Unlimited window scaling.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, maybe older
  • Processor: Any 64-bit processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 128 MB VRAM
  • Storage: 128 MB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Any 64-bit processor
  • Graphics: 512 MB VRAM
  • Storage: 128 MB available space

short_description: Guide the Hero on a journey to Change the World! Listen to their thoughts, listen to their fears! Speak to them with kindness and they might not come to hate you. Fight through tactical turn-based battles and awkward conversations alike. Choose your words and actions with care.
